original.statement: The behavior of Certificate spec.renewBeforePercentage was fixed to comply with its spec; the exact change is not described.

decision.reason: [ev-cae85181502c] says the release fixes the behavior of `renewBeforePercentage` so that it complies with its spec. That is a change in semantics, not a removal, rename or default change, so behavior-changed is the right type. The note doesn't name the resource kind, but the CRD schema check [ev-60054fcf0986][ev-84061d76ea1b] confirms that cert-manager.io Certificate spec.renewBeforePercentage exists in both releases. Leaving out the version is also right, because nothing in the evidence ties the change to a single API version.
